reason: S1 adds a complete PKM/ETC1 image-decoding path with attacker-controlled header, dimensions, block data, pixel conversion, and decoder state transitions, but H0 exclusively builds and exercises wuffs_jpeg__decoder. Consequently, no fuzz input reaches the new decoder or its format-specific parsing and block-processing logic.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JPEG, constructs wuffs_jpeg__decoder dec, and passes wuffs_jpeg__decoder__upcast_as__wuffs_base__image_decoder(&dec) to fuzz_image_decoder.
H0 contains no WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__ETC2 reference and never constructs or upcasts decoder from std/etc2/decode_etc2.wuffs.
decoder.do_decode_image_config? parses the 'PKM ' signature, version/pixel-format bytes, rounded dimensions, width, and height from src.
decoder.from_src_to_buffer? reads attacker-controlled 64-bit compressed blocks and drives decoder.decode_half_block!, CLAMP indexing, buffer offsets, and color reconstruction.

decoder.from_buffer_to_dst! processes edge dimensions, destination rows, pixel widths, and swizzler output, while decoder.restart_frame! and call_sequence expose additional state-machine behavior absent from H0's ETC2 coverage.
recommended_action: Add an ETC2/PKM fuzz target that enables the ETC2 module, initializes the ETC2 decoder with both initialization modes, and runs it through fuzz_image_decoder; also vary restart_frame! and resumable/short-read call sequences to cover the decoder state machine.
